title: Partition polynomial coefficient
statement: Let $p:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, $z\in\{−1,1\}^n$, and $\pi:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, and let $T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$. The partition polynomial coefficient at $T$ is $\sum_{S:\,J_\pi(S)=T}\widehat p(S)\,\chi_S(z)$, where $J_\pi(S)$ is the set of indices receiving an odd number of elements of $S$, $\widehat p(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $p$ at $S$, and $\chi_S(z)=\prod_{i\in S}z_i$.
